critical_remarks.issue: Missing in-text citation for the statement 'Recent computer vision-based approaches for BMI estimation have predominantly been limited to datasets of up to 7,211 full-body images or 14,500 facial images.'
critical_remarks.impact: Affects the credibility of the information presented.

critical_remarks.issue: Reference list lacks proper formatting with inconsistent spacing and alignment.
critical_remarks.impact: Reduces the readability and professionalism of the document.

critical_remarks.issue: Some references lack DOI or URL information.
critical_remarks.impact: Reduces the accessibility and traceability of the sources.

improvement_suggestions.original_text: Recent computer vision-based approaches for BMI estimation have predominantly been limited to datasets of up to 7,211 full-body images or 14,500 facial images.
improvement_suggestions.improved_version: Recent computer vision-based approaches for BMI estimation have predominantly been limited to datasets of up to 7,211 full-body images or 14,500 facial images (Jin et al., 2022).
improvement_suggestions.explanation: Adding an in-text citation improves the credibility and allows readers to trace the source.

improvement_suggestions.original_text: Jin et al. (2022) show state-of-the-art results, achieving a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 9.37% when estimating BMI from full-body images.
improvement_suggestions.improved_version: Jin et al. (2022) demonstrated state-of-the-art results, achieving a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 9.37% when estimating BMI from full-body images.
improvement_suggestions.explanation: Using 'demonstrated' instead of 'show' adds clarity and professionalism to the statement.

improvement_suggestions.original_text: Celeb-FBI: A Benchmark Dataset on Human Full Body Images and Age, Gender, Height and Weight Estimation using Deep Learning Approach, 2024.
improvement_suggestions.improved_version: Celeb-FBI: A Benchmark Dataset on Human Full Body Images and Age, Gender, Height and Weight Estimation using Deep Learning Approach.
improvement_suggestions.explanation: Remove the unnecessary publication year from the reference.

detailed_feedback.in_text_citation_format: In-text citations are generally well-formatted with author names and publication years. However, some statements lack proper citations, impacting the credibility of the information.
detailed_feedback.reference_list_format: The reference list lacks consistency in formatting, with issues in spacing and alignment. Improving the layout will enhance readability and professionalism.
detailed_feedback.citation_style_consistency: The citation style is mostly consistent, but there are instances where formatting can be improved for better coherence.
detailed_feedback.reference_completeness: References are generally complete, but some lack DOI or URL information, affecting the accessibility and traceability of the sources.
detailed_feedback.doi_url_formatting: DOI and URL formatting is inconsistent across references. Ensuring all sources have proper DOI or URL information will enhance the reliability of the document.
detailed_feedback.author_name_formatting: Author names are presented consistently, but ensuring proper capitalization and formatting will improve the overall presentation.
detailed_feedback.publication_date_formatting: Publication dates are mostly well-formatted, but ensuring uniformity in date style will enhance the professionalism of the document.
detailed_feedback.journal_name_formatting: Journal names are correctly formatted, but ensuring consistency in italics or abbreviation usage will improve the overall appearance.
detailed_feedback.volume_issue_page_formatting: Volume, issue, and page numbers are generally well-formatted, but ensuring uniformity in presentation style will enhance the reference list's readability.
detailed_feedback.cross_reference_accuracy: Cross-references are accurate and relevant, providing additional context and supporting information effectively.

summary: Overall, the document shows good adherence to citation formatting standards, with minor issues in in-text citations, reference list formatting, and DOI/URL completeness. Improvements in these areas will enhance the document's credibility and professionalism.
